data_fields.name: light_level_dim
data_fields.donor_constant: 0.2 (ratio; source comment says it is not tied to config)

best_idea: Split a per-frame grid pass into one vertical strip per worker, give each worker its own buffer, and merge with an order-free max, so the merge needs no ordering; the donor merges the whole buffer instead of the strip, which is the defect.
decision_why: Frankendom has no per-cell light grid to thread (Pit is a fixed arena, zones are data), and a browser build would need Web Workers and shared buffers for a feature we do not have; keep the shape as a note for any future grid pass.
acceptance: Not applicable while rejected. If revived: a worker-pool test asserts the merged grid equals a single-worker run on the same inputs, and a light near a strip edge lights cells on both sides.
